title: B2B Lead Gen: Failure Traps vs. Solutions
subtitle: Why generic volume fails & how modern operators convert high-intent pipeline

trap.title: The Volume Trap ("Spray & Pray")
trap.description: Blasting 2,000 generic emails with merge tags (`Hi {{FirstName}}`) and a Calendly link on email one.

solution.title: Signal-Based Sniper Outbound
solution.description: Target high-intent triggers (job transitions, funding rounds, visible competitor tooling via Clay/Apollo) with 3-line plain-text human messages.

trap.title: The Polished Brand Illusion
trap.description: Investing weeks in high-gloss corporate copy, feature lists, and stock agency imagery.

solution.title: "Useful Proof" & Transparency
solution.description: Share operational post-mortems, pricing lessons, failed experiments, and real screenshots. Unfiltered transparency builds instant peer credibility.

trap.title: The Pitch-First Outreach Bias
trap.description: Asking for a 15-minute call before providing any demonstrable value.

solution.title: The Pre-Built Asset Protocol
solution.description: Build a bespoke teardown, micro-draft, or workflow prototype for the account before outreach. Give them something tangible to react to.

trap.title: The Top-of-Funnel Vanity Metric
trap.description: Celebrating total lead form fills while sales reps complain about unqualified, unresponsive contacts.

solution.title: Upfront Friction & Disqualification
solution.description: Embed readiness quizzes, transparent pricing bounds, and process walkthroughs into the capture flow to intentionally filter out non-fits.

trap.title: The Single-Channel Dependency
trap.description: Relying 100% on cold email or paid ads and blaming copy when deliverability drops or ad costs spike.

solution.title: Coordinated Multi-Channel Stacks
solution.description: Orchestrate email, LinkedIn touches, and warm follow-up calls in synchronized sequences (e.g., via SmartReach) across the buyer's touchpoints.

trap.title: The Feature-Heavy Landing Page
trap.description: Structuring landing pages around product feature matrices rather than verified proof.

solution.title: Proof-First Landing Architecture
solution.description: Show real work, live before-and-after metrics, and verified customer screenshots above the fold; explain features second.
